purpose: Targeted development ablation: reduce unsupported near-zero-Odom deformation and limit known spatial range-mismatch influence. No position-dependent range correction is fitted.
hypotheses: Stronger existing relative-motion factors on past-only near-zero Odom candidates reduce stationary estimated path without hard-locking world coordinates.
Conservative per-link uncertainty scales from separate static measurements may limit range-induced pull; endpoint improvement is not guaranteed.

detector.policy: For each edge ending at t use raw Odom receipt samples no later than t. Require support over the entire 2s lookback, maximum gap/endpoint age <=0.2s, pose step rates and reported planar twist below thresholds. Change only covariance of existing Odom increment factors; preserve measured means, including small nonzero motion. No stationary-car label, command or truth in detector.

validation.source: user confirmation P07; continuation of L endpoint, not newly surveyed

range_confidence.formula: sigma_link = hypot(0.2 m, max over training bags of abs(corrected link median minus coordinate-reference 3D distance)); peer uses mean of the two whole-bag directional medians, without fitted offset.
range_confidence.loss: unchanged signed pseudo-Huber transform, unchanged Gaussian prior/Odom
range_confidence.range_bias_policy: Reuse all PR38 per-car wall offsets unchanged; no peer bias adjustment; no dynamic endpoint or 020151 validation measurement enters fitting.
range_confidence.meaning: Conservative heuristic scales from observed reference mismatch, not estimated Gaussian standard deviations or an identified position-dependent correction.

optimizer.initialization: aligned Odom; same initial states for independent and joint

evaluation_only.endpoints: Inherited last-five median antenna coordinates; all three bags are known development data.
evaluation_only.stationary_path: Estimated antenna path/net displacement and start-prior displacement; no fixed surveyed pose.
evaluation_only.negative_cases: Preserve all both-motion and synthetic complete wall-loss results, including worsened endpoints.

limitations: Full-bag offline batch only; not two-car sequential replay or fixed-lag.
Near-zero Odom plus twist is a candidate, not independent proof of physical rest; pushing, slipping or driver deadband can invalidate it.
Relative-motion covariance cannot fix a globally shifted stationary trajectory.
Training 015009 shares L-start geometry; validation 020151 shares L-end placement and Car1 training geometry. This is historical development and temporal transfer, not a blind test.
No continuous ground truth; manual reference uncertainty and Odom origin/heading remain unverified.
No new IMU factor. No parameter selection by the three dynamic endpoints.
